userCorrection: Reservation usability is primary. Payment UI is too prominent and complicated. Return to the original reservation-first proposal.
priorities: Current stays and today's reservations first
Direct reservation-number copy, original ticket/reservation opening and map directions
Compact upcoming list and collapsed past reservations
Amounts only as small optional metadata; payment and expense linking inside editing

options.prompt: Create a 390 × 844 mobile TripLOG “예약 지갑” screen. Date anchor: October 28, 2026. Prioritize practical reservation retrieval: “지금 필요한 예약”, upcoming reservations, collapsed past reservations. Compact TripLOG header, small add button, search and type filters. White surfaces, navy Korean type, yellow #fff05a primary actions, pale blue/pink accents, crisp outlines and small offset shadows. Use reusable colorful hotel, ticket and airplane category icons. Show an ongoing “니시스가모 호텔 / 10.27–10.31 · 4박” card with copyable booking number, short address, “길찾기” and “예약 열기”. Show “오늘 18:30 시부야 스카이” with “티켓 열기” and number copy. Show compact upcoming “10.31 나리타 → 인천” with departure time and booking number. Prices are tiny optional metadata only. Keep payment, expense-link settings and editing behind small pencil icons; show no payment forms, balances or expense panels. Preserve bottom navigation “개요 · 일정 · 지출 · 리포트 · 설정”. Fit several readable reservations, without decorative illustrations or explanatory paragraphs.

options.prompt: Design a 390 × 844 TripLOG “예약 지갑” mobile screen centered on a compact date-grouped reservation list. Date anchor October 28, 2026. Use white backgrounds, dark navy Korean typography, yellow #fff05a action buttons, pale blue and pink status accents, dark outlines and modest offset shadows. Small TripLOG header without a slogan, search, compact type filter and add icon. Pin a concise ongoing “니시스가모 호텔 / 10.27–10.31 · 숙박 중” section with booking-number copy, address copy, “길찾기” and “예약 열기”. Below, date groups “오늘 10.28 수” and “10.31 토” contain “18:30 시부야 스카이” and “10:20 나리타 → 인천”. Give each row a reusable colorful category icon, short useful details, copyable number and direct ticket/reservation-open action. Include a small itinerary-link icon and edit pencil. Collapse “지난 예약” at the bottom. A price may appear only as tiny secondary metadata. Payment and expense-link settings stay inside editing and are absent from this screen. Bottom navigation reads “개요 · 일정 · 지출 · 리포트 · 설정”, with 일정 selected. Keep text short and information dense without crowding; no payment forms, expense summaries or large decorative art.

options.prompt: Create a compact 390 × 844 TripLOG “예약 지갑” mobile screen. Date anchor October 28, 2026. Under “지금 필요한 예약”, place two readable cards in a mobile two-column layout: “숙박 중 / 니시스가모 호텔 / 10.27–10.31” with generic colorful hotel icon, booking-number copy and “길찾기”; “오늘 18:30 / 시부야 스카이” with colorful ticket icon, booking-number copy and “티켓 열기”. Each card has a small detail/edit icon; keep labels short and typography readable. Below, full-width concise date-ordered rows show “내일 12:00 식당 예약” and “10.31 10:20 나리타 → 인천”, with reference copy and reservation-open icons. Add collapsed “지난 예약”. Keep prices inconspicuous, and keep all payment and expense-link controls inside the edit screen rather than this wallet. Retain navigation “개요 · 일정 · 지출 · 리포트 · 설정”, 일정 selected. No slogan, large artwork, explanatory paragraphs or financial panels.
